description: The event object of onSelectionChanged (epic 4 entry 8, docs/contract.md): fired once per change of the selected set, with the selected map items in the order each joined.

mapItems.description: The selected map items as AD-7 map item objects (id, name, kind, assetId, properties, basePath, alarmsPath, values; a line adds its instruments and segment), in the order each joined, the last the current item; empty when nothing is selected. The selectedItems prop carries their ids.
